provenance.source: Unmodified GPU_BENCHMARK_WORKLOAD, GPU_BENCHMARK_PAIR and GPU_BENCHMARK_RESULT JSON records from the completed job log.
provenance.quantiles: Nearest-rank p50/p95. Original median / *Median fields contain p50 order statistics; for n=6 or n=4, p50 is the lower middle observation and p95 is the maximum.
provenance.pixelScope: Cross-revision initial RGB images are compared exactly. Each final image independently passes the shared GPU/SVG quality gates.
provenance.rawSamples: Preserved separately in the linked workflow artifact.
